guild.name: NightShift
guild.tagline: Every pull, every wipe, every questionable decision. For the Horde.
guild.wip: NightShift's logs are still being crawled and alts are not matched to their mains yet: names and numbers will move.

ghosts.title: Ghosts of {guild}
ghosts.description: They raided with {guild}, but fewer than {min_weeks} reset weeks: not enough to enter the rankings. Their pulls still count in the guild totals.

intro._doc: Dismissible 'how to read' panel at the top of the guild home, shown until the viewer clicks dismiss (remembered in localStorage). The footer link reopens it. items: [term, text].
intro.title: How to read this site
items: scores compare you with the median player of your role on the same pull, who scores 100: 120 is 20% above, so Molten Core and Siege of Orgrimmar compare fairly.
rank you against the guild: 90th means better than 90% of the raiders under the same filters.
mark the two ends of an achievement: its title for the top, its flip title for the bottom.
(expansion, role, class) work on every page and stay in the link you share.
is a PvP rank: one rank per raid tier cleared. The coloured dots are the classes played.
open a player's page. The search at the top finds a main or any of their alts.

best_friend.title: Your best friend
best_friend.none: No raid night shared with a ranked player

stats.title: Hours Raiding
stats.description: Time well spent. Probably.
stats.detail: Each raid night, from his first to his last eligible boss pull (trash in between included, before the first boss not counted).

stats.title: Boss Kills
stats.description: Every single one dropped the wrong trinket.
stats.detail: Eligible boss kills attended.

stats.title: Wipes
stats.description: Character building, one corpse run at a time.
stats.detail: Eligible boss wipes attended.

stats.title: Damage Done
stats.description: The meter doesn't stop between bosses. Neither does he.
stats.detail: Damage dealt on eligible boss pulls (kills and wipes) and on the trash of the same raid nights, on every target. Ranked in Blackwing Lair (Era) terms, to compare expansions: each boss pull counts as the seconds of the pull's median DPS it is worth, at the guild's median DPS on BWL kills; a night's trash is converted at the rate of that night's boss pulls. The actual total is in brackets. Trash damage is counted only for the nights already crawled.

stats.title: Damage Done to Bosses
stats.description: The only damage that makes it into the parse.
stats.detail: Damage dealt on eligible boss pulls (kills and wipes), on every target. Ranked in Blackwing Lair (Era) terms, to compare expansions: each pull counts as the seconds of the pull's median DPS it is worth, at the guild's median DPS on BWL kills. The actual total is in brackets.

stats.title: Damage Taken
stats.description: Some take damage. Some take all of it.
stats.detail: Damage taken on eligible boss pulls (kills and wipes), from every source. Ranked in Blackwing Lair (Era) terms, to compare expansions: each pull counts as the seconds of the raid's average damage taken it is worth (mean of the raid: in 40-man raids the median player takes next to nothing), at the guild's median on BWL kills. The actual total is in brackets.

stats.title: Healing Done
stats.description: Effective healing only. All of it legitimate… right?
stats.detail: Effective healing on eligible boss pulls (kills and wipes), overhealing left out. Ranked in Blackwing Lair (Era) terms, to compare expansions: each pull counts as the seconds of the pull's median healer it is worth, at the guild's median HPS on BWL kills. The actual total is in brackets.

stats.title: The Gang
stats.description: Raid invite? Already in the group.
stats.detail: Distinct reset weeks with at least one eligible pull.

stats.title: Identity Crisis
stats.description: Asks "what should I play next tier?" every tier.
stats.detail: Distinct characters raided on, each with at least 5 reset weeks (minor rerolls left out).

stats.title: Kill Collector
stats.description: Gotta kill 'em all.
stats.detail: Distinct bosses killed (encounter × difficulty).

stats.title: The Immortal
stats.description: Wipe, run back, play the soundboard, repeat.
stats.detail: Wipes attended, as a share of pulls.

stats.title: Lucky Charm
stats.description: Bring him to prog. Or don't. The logs have opinions.
stats.detail: Guild wipe rate on a boss when he is in the raid, minus its wipe rate on that boss without him. Below zero: fewer wipes with him.

stats.title: Fishbait
stats.description: First one down, so the rest know where to lie.
stats.detail: Share of pulls where he dies first, scripted deaths excluded.

stats.title: Floor Inspector
stats.description: Five stars. Would lie down again.
stats.detail: Deaths per pull, kills and wipes.

stats.title: The Roach
stats.description: "Women and children first." He misheard.
stats.detail: Wipes he survived, as a share of his wipes.

stats.title: Last Stand
stats.description: Still standing when half the raid isn't. Someone has to loot.
stats.detail: Kills where fewer than half the raid was alive at the end, him included.

stats.title: Arch-Nemesis
stats.description: Same spell, different raid night.
stats.detail: Ability that killed him most often, melee hits left out.

stats.title: Healers Love Him
stats.description: Healers have favourites. They just won't admit it.
stats.detail: Healing received from other players (his own heals, potions and healthstones left out), base 100 vs his role on the same boss, then vs the players of his class (warlocks, with Life Tap, are healed far more than other DPS): the median of their averages, one vote per player with at least 10 pulls.

stats.title: Mechanic Magnet
stats.description: If it glows on the floor, he's standing in it.
stats.detail: Damage taken from avoidable abilities, base 100 vs his role.

stats.title: The Junky
stats.description: The pull timer waits for his potion cooldown.
stats.detail: Potions and healthstones used per pull.

stats.title: The Unprepared
stats.description: Bare gear, full confidence.
stats.detail: Share of enchantable slots left without an enchant, per kill.

stats.title: Parse Lord
stats.description: Purple is a personality.
stats.detail: Warcraft Logs parses on {guild} kills (percentile against every player of his spec worldwide): for each boss, the average of his best and his median parse (both against the rankings at the time of each kill), then the average over his kills (each boss weighs its number of kills, whichever character played them). Every role, tanks included. The only achievement not measured against the guild.

stats.title: Overachiever
stats.description: Out-parsed you in quest greens. Someone uninstalled.
stats.detail: Performance score (base 100) minus the average of guild players in the same role whose item level, relative to their raid, matches his (±1 in Classic Era, ±2 later). DPS and healers, kills only.

stats.title: Metronome
stats.description: Same number every week, to the decimal.
stats.detail: How much his performance score swings from one kill to the next (standard deviation). Lower is better: the steadier he is, the more Metronome. DPS and healers.

stats.title: The Nut Crusher
stats.description: Kicks where it hurts. Your cast bar is merely a suggestion.
stats.detail: Interrupts per hour, on boss pulls and raid nights' trash where the raid interrupted something. Counted from 10 such pulls (a night's trash counts as one).

stats.title: The Janitor
stats.description: Dispel first, ask what it was later.
stats.detail: Dispels per pull.

stats.title: The Sweat
stats.description: Hasn't blinked since Molten Core.
stats.detail: Active time as a share of the pull.

stats.title: Comfort Boss
stats.description: Everyone has a boss that's secretly a training dummy.
stats.detail: Boss where his average performance score is highest. DPS and healers.

stats.title: The Terrorist
stats.description: Mind controlled. Allegedly.
stats.detail: His share of the raid's friendly fire (damage dealt to other raid members) over the boss pulls and the raid nights' trash he was in: his friendly damage divided by the raid's. Big friendly fire pulls (Yogg-Saron's mind control) weigh more than a stray hit. Counted from 10 pulls (or nights' trash) where the raid did friendly fire.

stats.title: Clutch Player
stats.description: Farm nights are practice. First kills are game day.
stats.detail: Average score on guild first kills, compared to his score on farm kills. DPS and healers.

stats.title: Glow Up
stats.description: Started in greens. Ended on top of the meters.
stats.detail: Trend of his performance score over the weeks (regression slope, score points per week). DPS and healers, only players with scored kills in at least 3 raid tiers under the filters.

stats.title: Heartbreaker
stats.description: Close enough to taste the loot. Not to roll on it.
stats.detail: Wipes with the boss under 5% health, as a share of his wipes.

stats.title: Spectator
stats.description: Watched the kill in third person.
stats.detail: Kills he watched from the floor: kills where he died (scripted deaths excluded), as a share of his kills.

stats.title: Iron Man
stats.description: Birthdays, weddings, Christmas: raid night anyway.
stats.detail: Longest run of consecutive reset weeks raided. Weeks when the guild did not raid are skipped, not counted as absences.

stats.title: Comeback Kid
stats.description: "I'm done with this game." Several times.
stats.detail: Longest absence before a comeback: reset weeks the guild raided without him, between two weeks he raided.

stats.title: Late Arrival
stats.description: Traffic, dinner, patch download: a new excuse every week.
stats.detail: Share of his raid nights where he missed every pull of the night's first boss. Nights with at least two bosses.

stats.title: Early Leaver
stats.description: "One more pull" never applied to him.
stats.detail: Share of his raid nights where he missed every pull of the night's last boss. Nights with at least two bosses.

stats.title: Loot Hoarder
stats.description: Somehow always the best geared. The loot council has no comment.
stats.detail: Share of the raid he out-geared (item level, ties count half), averaged over his kills.

stats.title: Self-Made
stats.description: Who needs healers? Leech, potions and pure spite.
stats.detail: Share of the healing he received that came from himself: self-heals, potions, healthstones, leech. Kills and wipes.

stats.title: Guardian Angel
stats.description: Some heals are personal.
stats.detail: Healer who healed him the most, and the share of the healing he got from the guild's healers that came from that one (total in brackets). Only healers who healed him on at least 10 pulls.

stats.title: Personal Hell
stats.description: Saw that boss more often than his family.
stats.detail: Boss he wiped on most often.

stats.title: Obliterated
stats.description: Not just dead. Closed-casket dead.
stats.detail: His biggest overkill (damage beyond what killed him), as a multiple of the usual overkill in that expansion (median of the guild's deaths), with the ability, the boss and the date. Scripted deaths and instant kill mechanics left out.

stats.title: Suicide Pact
stats.description: Ride or die. Mostly die.
stats.detail: Raider he died with most often: both dead within 10 seconds, before a fifth of the raid is down (the wipe itself does not count).

stats.title: Pioneer
stats.description: In the first-kill screenshot. And in every wipe before it.
stats.detail: Guild first kills attended (each boss and difficulty).

stats.title: Damage Sponge
stats.description: The boss's favourite chew toy.
stats.detail: Share of the pull's tank damage taken, base 100 vs tanks on the same boss.

stats.title: Brick Wall
stats.description: The healers fall over before he does.
stats.detail: Deaths per pull as tank.

stats.title: Secret DPS
stats.description: Threat is just a DPS meter if you squint.
stats.detail: Damage done, base 100 vs tanks on the same boss.

stats.title: Add Wrangler
stats.description: If it spawns, it's his.
stats.detail: Share of damage taken from adds rather than the boss.

stats.title: Pacemaker
stats.description: Pulls when he's ready. He's always ready.
stats.detail: Kill duration when he tanks, base 100 vs the median duration for that boss.

stats.title: Attention Seeker
stats.description: Look at me. No, ME.
stats.detail: Taunts per minute, on boss pulls and on the trash of the nights he tanked.

stats.title: Blamed the Healer
stats.description: His cooldowns were perfect. His healers, apparently, were not.
stats.detail: Share of his deaths as a tank with a defensive cooldown active (Shield Wall, Survival Instincts, Icebound Fortitude, Pain Suppression...; not Divine Sacrifice or Dancing Rune Weapon), scripted deaths excluded. Total deaths as a tank alongside. At least 30 deaths as a tank.

stats.title: Healing Machine
stats.description: Mana is temporary. The meter is forever.
stats.detail: Effective healing, base 100 vs healers in the pull.

stats.title: Sniper
stats.description: Fastest heals in the raid. Yours land on a full health bar.
stats.detail: Overheal share, overheal / (effective healing + overheal), base 100 vs the healers of his class in the expansion: overheal depends mostly on the class (Beacon of Light, HoTs, absorbs). Lower is better: his heals land before anyone else's. High: Sniped, his heals land on targets someone else already topped up.

stats.title: Tank's Personal Nurse
stats.description: Laser-focused on the tank, or whack-a-mole on the raid frames.
stats.detail: Share of healing done on tanks.

stats.title: Smite Lord
stats.description: Who needs heals when the boss is dead?
stats.detail: Damage done, base 100 vs healers in the pull.

stats.title: Favorite Patient
stats.description: The healer's favourite. Rumour says gold changed hands.
stats.detail: Player he healed the most, and the share of his healing on other raiders that went to him (total in brackets). Only patients healed on at least 10 pulls.

stats.title: Parse Fiend
stats.description: Stood in the fire to heal it back. For the logs.
stats.detail: Self-healing covering his own avoidable damage, base 100 vs healers in the pull.

stats.title: Big Pumper
stats.description: Carries the raid on his back. The meters agree.
stats.detail: Damage done, base 100 vs DPS in the pull.

stats.title: Main Character Moment
stats.description: Screenshotted, framed, posted in Discord.
stats.detail: Best single-pull score, with the boss and the date.

stats.title: Tunnel Vision
stats.description: Adds don't count towards the parse.
stats.detail: Share of damage done on the boss rather than adds.

stats.title: One Button Wonder
stats.description: Found the best button. Pressed it until the keycap wore off.
stats.detail: Share of damage from his top ability, base 100 vs his class.

stats.title: Final Boss Energy
stats.description: Last boss of the night: finds a sixth gear to get home sooner.
stats.detail: Performance score (base 100) on the final bosses of raids, minus his score on the other bosses. Kills only.

stats.title: Timekeeper
stats.description: The trash is dead before the tank finds it.
stats.detail: Share of the raid's damage on trash over the night, base 100 vs the night's DPS, then vs the players of his class in the expansion (AoE classes do far more trash damage). Nights where he tanked a boss are left out.

stats.title: Engineer's Pride
stats.description: Sapper first, apologise later.
stats.detail: Damage from bombs, rockets and sappers.
